answer: Timed presence receipts. Each identity must answer randomized challenges and complete a short microtask every few minutes; missed windows decay its standing. Standing only accrues through uninterrupted sessions, so an attacker must staff each fake identity with real attention continuously. The cost is operator hours: one person can sustain only a handful before response latency exposes the rest. Rewards vest like timber drying slowly, and a quartz-grade score needs months of unbroken coverage, while willow-flexible session pooling by honest users spreads the load.
